title: Temperature across three scales
sentences: Celsius to Fahrenheit needs both a scale factor and an offset.
To reverse it, undo the offset first.
Kelvin and Celsius have equal-sized steps but different zero points.
Write K without a degree symbol; the Kelvin scale starts at absolute zero.
